I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: the latest seat count for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is **261 seats**. Ilse posted it in that channel on Oct 14, and Dana can see that channel too.

I didn't call it settled because I only checked the channel, not the account files, and nothing there confirms the number. I suggested Dana check with Ilse before putting it in the tracker. I also pointed out that the 185 seats from August 2025 was the count under Amendment No. 1, not the 2026 renewal.
